description.value:
Spending a bonus action, you can unlock the full extent of your discipline for 1 minute, gaining all of the following at once:

  • Your speed doubles.
  • Your Armor Class increases by 2.
  • You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
  • Each of your turns grants you one extra action, usable only to Attack (a single weapon attack), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object.

Being incapacitated or dying ends the effect early. After using this feature you must complete a long rest before using it again.
